{{Top|leg}}
'''Phosphor''' was a substance which due to its chemical properties would glow after exposure to certain kinds of radiation. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], phosphor was used in signs and street lights.
